Container.Name: mem-zero
Container.Overview: Self-hosted memory server for AI coding assistants. Store, search, and manage persistent context across sessions so your tools remember what happened last week without stuffing everything into the context window. Each project gets its own isolated vector collection with automatic fact extraction, deduplication, and semantic search. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible client. Includes a bundled LLM for zero-config operation, or connect to Ollama or OpenAI for better quality. Web dashboard included for browsing and managing memories.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web dashboard and MCP server HTTP port

Config.Name: Qdrant Port
Config.Description: Qdrant API port (optional, for direct access)

Config.Name: LLM Backend
Config.Description: Leave blank to auto-detect: openai if OpenAI API Key is set, else ollama if Ollama URL is set, else bundled. Set explicitly only to override. NOTE: an explicit 'bundled' ignores your Ollama/OpenAI settings.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Ollama API base URL (only used when backend=ollama)

Config.Name: LLM Model
Config.Description: Ollama language model (only used when backend=ollama)

Config.Name: Embedder Model
Config.Description: Ollama embedding model (only used when backend=ollama)

Config.Name: Embedder Dimensions
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank for the per-backend default (768 for Ollama/bundled, the model's native size for OpenAI). Set only to override.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: API key for OpenAI-compatible backend (only used when backend=openai)

Config.Name: OpenAI Base URL
Config.Description: Base URL for any OpenAI-compatible API serving BOTH /chat/completions and /embeddings (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM)

Config.Name: Bundled Threads
Config.Description: CPU threads for bundled LLM inference

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: API key for MCP and REST endpoints (leave empty to disable). Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Dashboard Username
Config.Description: Username for web dashboard login (leave empty to disable auth)

Config.Name: Dashboard Password
Config.Description: Password for web dashboard login (leave empty to disable auth)

Config.Name: Diagnostics
Config.Description: Enable performance and accuracy metrics on the dashboard

Config.Name: Rerank Enabled
Config.Description: Re-score search results with a local cross-encoder for sharper relevance separation (CPU; downloads a small model on first use)

Config.Name: Rerank Model
Config.Description: Cross-encoder model used when Rerank Enabled is true
